title: orbea wissmannii subsp. eremastrum
intro: Orbea wissmannii subsp. eremastrum, commonly known as the "Hoodia cactus," is a succulent plant species belonging to the family Apocynaceae. It has been traditionally used in South African folk medicine to aid in weight loss and reduce hunger, making it a popular ingredient in dietary supplements. The plant has been reported to exhibit potential health benefits, including reducing appetite and improving glucose metabolism, due to its therapeutic actions such as inhibiting gastric emptying and increasing feelings of fullness. The bioactive constituents of Orbea wissmannii subsp. eremastrum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
